schema_basis.scope: Base fields and selected Location, Collective, Institution, Object, Narrative, Language, Species, and Relation groupings; SERVATI controls remain a separate extension.

world_reference.note: Retained from the working pack solely for interoperability; it is not a canon world entity.

entries.Name: Relay Twelve Primary System
entries.Description: DRAFT parent setting for the Pale Reef. The radiator geometry implies a vacuum installation with a long clear thermal view; the primary, orbit, distances, and formation history are unknown.

Setting.form: A deliberately underspecified stellar system containing Relay Twelve; no star class or orbital elements are assigned.
Setting.function: Provide the radiative and route environment in which the Pale Reef remains operable.

provenance.note: V11 supports an isolated relay and an archive reef with exposed radiator fins. This system interpretation and every astronomical detail are DRAFT.
DRAFT qualitative constraints only; no generated system was adopted.

claims.claim: The habitat can reject operational heat through exposed radiators in vacuum.
claims.basis: General radiative heat-transfer principle; geometry and heat load remain unspecified.

claims.claim: The stellar primary and station orbit are suitable for long-duration archive survival.
claims.basis: No stellar class, flux, radiation environment, or orbit is supplied by V11.

science_review.review_note: Requires an energy budget, radiator-area estimate, orbit, and radiation assessment before any numerical detail is added.

servati.preservation_problem: System science must remain useful enough to constrain the Reef without turning absent V11 astronomy into false certainty.
servati.editorial_notes: DRAFT astronomical setting; qualitative only.

entries.Name: Transfer Cluster K-6 Debris System
entries.Description: DRAFT parent setting for the Ash Roads. A dusty excavated minor body is consistent with an airless debris environment, but its size, composition, spin, orbit, and origin are not established.

Setting.form: A debris-bearing system containing the mined body designated K-6; no numerical architecture is proposed.
Setting.function: Provide mineral mass, low-gravity transport constraints, and a route context for burden custody.

provenance.note: V11 supports an unnamed dust-choked asteroid Lamp. The K-6 system and all physical particulars are DRAFT.
DRAFT qualitative constraints only; legacy accretion generators were not treated as scientific proof.

claims.claim: An excavated airless minor body can retain mechanically cut internal roads.
claims.basis: Rock mechanics and low-gravity construction make the broad setting plausible, not the detailed geometry.

claims.claim: K-6 is dynamically stable and materially suitable for long custody.
claims.basis: Size, cohesion, spin state, composition, impacts, and orbit are unknown.

science_review.review_note: Requires a rubble-pile versus monolithic-body decision, structural model, dust-control model, and orbital context.

servati.preservation_problem: The body must remain stable enough to hold burdens while excavation, spin, and dust movement continually alter the evidence-bearing roads.
servati.editorial_notes: DRAFT astronomical setting; qualitative only.

entries.Name: Pelagic Seven Planet-Moon System
entries.Description: DRAFT parent setting for the Drowned Threshold. V11 establishes a Lamp above a drowned moon; this profile withholds the primary, host planet, ocean depth, chemistry, and orbital geometry.

Setting.form: An unspecified planet-moon system containing an ocean-bearing moon and an orbital or elevated custody installation.
Setting.function: Sustain the black-water environment and the station-to-vault access chain.

provenance.note: V11 supports a Lamp above a drowned moon, black water, coral-like towers, and pressure-adapted custodians. Pelagic Seven and all added system details are DRAFT.
DRAFT qualitative constraints only; ocean retention and habitability have not been modelled.

claims.claim: A moon can retain a deep global or near-global ocean and support submerged engineered structures.
claims.basis: Ocean worlds are scientifically plausible; V11 does not specify whether the water is surface, subsurface, natural, or engineered.

claims.claim: The vault access, pressure ecology, and station position are mutually viable.
claims.basis: Gravity, pressure, chemistry, tides, radiation, and transfer mechanics are unknown.

science_review.review_note: Requires planetary mass/radius bounds, water phase and chemistry, tidal heating, radiation environment, and access engineering.

servati.preservation_problem: Any scientific specification of the moon changes what pressure, route, and transfer can mean, so unsupported precision would distort the custody problem.
servati.editorial_notes: DRAFT astronomical setting; qualitative only.

entries.Name: Seed Reserve Thirty-One Cold-Body System
entries.Description: DRAFT parent setting for the Unopened Spring. The reserve is placed in or around a cold body only as a candidate inference from V11's broader Seed Lamp imagery, not as a settled fact.

Setting.form: An unspecified dim-body environment with a buried or shielded cryogenic custody complex.
Setting.function: Provide passive thermal margin and shielding while the reserve maintains active viability systems.

provenance.note: V11 supports a Seed Lamp with obsolete release conditions and separately allows seed vessels in ice bodies and seed arks orbiting dim bodies. Their combination here is DRAFT.
DRAFT qualitative thermal concept; viability duration and energy supply are unmodelled.

claims.claim: A cold exterior can reduce but not eliminate active cryogenic and maintenance requirements.
claims.basis: Passive thermal environment can improve margin; living material still needs controlled conditions and repair.

claims.claim: The reserve can keep its stated biological range viable over deep time.
claims.basis: Storage modes, repair, radiation dose, energy source, and sampling strategy are unspecified.

science_review.review_note: Requires a biological inventory, viability protocol, shielding and dose model, maintenance ecology, and heat/power budget.

servati.preservation_problem: A colder and more isolated reserve protects viability but makes inspection, repair, and accountable release harder.
servati.editorial_notes: DRAFT astronomical setting; inferred combination, not V11 fact.

entries.Name: No-Arrival Interstellar Reach
entries.Description: DRAFT astronomical setting for the Corridor of No Arrival. It is a route-scale region rather than a claim that one conventional stellar system contains every beacon.

Setting.form: A chain of unplaced deep-space beacons and service refuges between unidentified route anchors.
Setting.function: Keep a transfer path inspectable and answerable after traffic and endpoint confirmation have ceased.

provenance.note: V11 supports a route Lamp maintaining unused beacon corridors. The reach, anchors, and all route geometry are DRAFT.
DRAFT route abstraction; no faster-than-light, distance, or travel-time claim is made.

claims.claim: A distributed beacon chain requires independent power, navigation references, station-keeping, and repair access.
The route is traversable under SERVATI transport physics.
claims.basis: V11 supplies no distances, propulsion model, endpoint motion, or travel times for this candidate corridor.

science_review.review_note: Requires an explicit transport model and anchor geometry before map placement; the cluster is relational, not a claimed spatial neighbourhood.

servati.preservation_problem: Mapping the route too precisely would manufacture transport physics, while leaving it wholly abstract weakens the custodians' maintenance problem.
servati.editorial_notes: DRAFT route-scale astronomical setting; no map coordinates.

entries.Name: Transfer Site Nine Junction Environment
entries.Description: DRAFT parent setting for the Broken Frame Concordance. It is treated as an engineered transfer junction with a damaged local debris field; whether it is planetary, orbital, or free-space remains open.

Setting.form: An unplaced junction environment containing damaged burden frames and comparison infrastructure.
Setting.function: Provide a convergence point for matter, memory, and pattern custody routes.

provenance.note: V11 supports damaged burden-capsule fragments and mixed-site vulnerability separately. This junction environment and their combination are DRAFT.
DRAFT topology only; no orbit, impact history, or artificial-gravity model is assigned.

claims.claim: A transfer junction can accumulate damaged frames and require controlled relative-motion operations.
claims.basis: General orbital or free-space operations; the exact setting remains open.

claims.claim: The comparison field and debris can be maintained safely in the same environment.
claims.basis: No station architecture, orbit, shielding, debris dynamics, or failure mode has been specified.

science_review.review_note: Requires selection of a physical setting and a debris/traffic model before visual or orbital detail is approved.

servati.preservation_problem: A scientifically vague junction cannot support scenes, but choosing a physical model too early could turn a DRAFT synthesis into apparent canon.
servati.editorial_notes: DRAFT astronomical setting; physical category intentionally unresolved.

entries.Name: Rib Quiet Office
entries.Description: DRAFT Relay Twelve institution that treats silence as an instrument with logged limits, not as permission to leave unqueried identities permanently isolated.

Foundation.doctrine: Every imposed quiet must name what it protects, what evidence would end it, and which unanswered witnesses it excludes.

provenance.note: V11 supports silence cultures and the Quiet Route. The Office, its conditional doctrine, and its procedures are DRAFT.

servati.preservation_problem: Its logs must preserve why silence was imposed without turning a temporary protection into unquestionable sacred law.
servati.editorial_notes: DRAFT local institution and Archive Faith divergence.

entries.Name: Assembly of Measured Handoffs
entries.Description: DRAFT K-6 institution whose benches certify a burden transfer only when load, route, pause, carrier, and dissent remain physically inspectable.

Foundation.doctrine: Weight creates accountability only when the passage of weight leaves evidence another custodian can challenge.

provenance.note: V11 supports hand-carried burdens, the Weight Doctrine, and contested convoy redirection. This Assembly and audit doctrine are DRAFT.

servati.preservation_problem: A complete physical audit trail can become so burdensome that urgent custody is delayed until the held matter is endangered.
servati.editorial_notes: DRAFT local institution and Weight Doctrine divergence.

entries.Name: Threshold Sounding Office
entries.Description: DRAFT Pelagic institution that certifies submerged access routes and records a marker together with its pressure, current, orientation, and approach sequence.

Foundation.doctrine: A record reached by the wrong threshold is evidence removed from part of itself.

provenance.note: V11 supports pressure-adapted custodians and drowned route markers. The Office and its contextual doctrine are DRAFT.

servati.preservation_problem: Reproducing full context protects meaning but can make evacuation of a failing submerged archive procedurally impossible.
servati.editorial_notes: DRAFT local institution and place-centred doctrine.

entries.Name: Chamber of Plural Release
entries.Description: DRAFT Seed Reserve Thirty-One institution that maintains incompatible readings of obsolete release conditions and requires each activation claim to expose its irreversible exclusions.

Foundation.doctrine: Non-release is an active custody decision, not a morally neutral default; no single surviving authority may conceal that decision's losses.

provenance.note: V11 supports obsolete release conditions, doctrinal opening, and false release orders. The Chamber and plural procedure are DRAFT.

servati.preservation_problem: It must record the harm of waiting without letting accumulated harm become a forged mandate to open the reserve.
servati.editorial_notes: DRAFT local institution and Seed/Ritual divergence.

entries.Name: Office of Unanswered Intervals
entries.Description: DRAFT route institution that keeps receiving windows, failed acknowledgements, and beacon repairs mutually legible without pretending that maintenance proves a destination survives.

Foundation.doctrine: The route owes a faithful opportunity to answer; it does not owe an invented arrival.

provenance.note: V11 supports an unused beacon corridor and route checksum becoming litany. This Office and answer/arrival distinction are DRAFT.

servati.preservation_problem: A maintained interval can preserve honest readiness or become a ritual that consumes the capacity needed to investigate why no answer comes.
servati.editorial_notes: DRAFT local institution and route-faith divergence.

entries.Name: Concordance of Unequal Fragments
entries.Description: DRAFT Transfer Site Nine institution composed of three custody benches that may act together without declaring matter, record, and pattern equivalent.

Foundation.doctrine: No fragment may close the meaning of another; action must retain the dissent that made it provisional.

provenance.note: V11 supports mixed sites and loss of comparison. This Concordance, its benches, and its rule are DRAFT.

servati.preservation_problem: Its refusal to collapse disagreement preserves evidence but can prevent time-critical repairs that necessarily privilege one account.
servati.editorial_notes: DRAFT plural custody institution.

entries.Name: Ribside Witness Houses
entries.Description: DRAFT Relay Twelve culture organised in small houses that alternate quiet maintenance, remote comparison, and explicit accounting for records they cannot safely query.

Formation.composition: Mixed households of archive readers, thermal maintainers, contradiction witnesses, and juveniles learning sealcloth gesture.

Dynamics.activity: Rotate between silent reef work and shielded sessions in which conflicting identity records are compared aloud or by gesture.
Dynamics.disposition: Patient with contradiction, suspicious of urgent broadcast claims.
Dynamics.state: Active but divided over whether the Silence Breach proved isolation or transmission more dangerous.

provenance.note: V11 supports silence-shaped Lamp cultures and the Quiet Route. These houses and all social particulars are DRAFT.

servati.preservation_problem: House rotation distributes custody knowledge but also divides responsibility so thoroughly that an excluded record may have no accountable advocate.
servati.editorial_notes: DRAFT local culture.

entries.Name: Road-Bearer Benches
entries.Description: DRAFT K-6 culture in which a bench is simultaneously a rest place, a witness group, and the unit that inherits responsibility for a section of burden road.

Formation.composition: Load bearers, frame repairers, route readers, and dissent witnesses attached to one sequence of resting thresholds.

Dynamics.activity: Carry, rest, inspect, and annotate burdens in overlapping shifts so no transfer has a single unobserved owner.
Dynamics.disposition: Slow to accept remote evidence; candid about physical failure.
Dynamics.state: The benches preserve mutually incompatible route records left by the Ash Convoy redirection.

provenance.note: V11 supports hand-carried burdens, resting thresholds, and convoy redirection. The benches and their social structure are DRAFT.

servati.preservation_problem: The culture preserves the route through bodily practice, but injury, demographic loss, or a changed road can erase evidence never externalised.
servati.editorial_notes: DRAFT local culture.

entries.Name: Depth-Route Households
entries.Description: DRAFT Pelagic culture whose households inherit a set of submerged approaches rather than a fixed dwelling, treating current change as part of the archive's continuing history.

Formation.composition: Pressure-route custodians, tower maintainers, surface liaisons, and current readers associated with one family of thresholds.

Dynamics.activity: Sound routes, replace only failed surfaces, and teach records through repeated embodied approaches.
Dynamics.disposition: Context-sensitive and resistant to decontextualised copies.
Dynamics.state: Reconstructing the route relations severed by the Drowned Marker Seizure without claiming they are recoverable.

provenance.note: V11 supports pressure-adapted custodians and drowned marker conflict. These households and practices are DRAFT.

servati.preservation_problem: Living routes keep context attached to records, yet natural current change means exact repetition can itself become false evidence.
servati.editorial_notes: DRAFT local culture.

entries.Name: Readiness Gardens
entries.Description: DRAFT Reserve Thirty-One culture divided into rotating garden cohorts that maintain test ecologies, sterile thresholds, and opposing release arguments.

Formation.composition: Viability tenders, contamination witnesses, trial-ecology keepers, and paired advocates for release and continued dormancy.

Dynamics.activity: Repeat readiness trials while preserving failed conditions, minority interpretations, and the biological cost of delay.
Dynamics.disposition: Procedurally divided; neither optimism nor refusal may speak without an assigned critic.
Dynamics.state: Maintaining closure after the False Release while distrusting remote authority.

provenance.note: V11 supports obsolete release conditions and contested or false release. The gardens and paired-advocate culture are DRAFT.

servati.preservation_problem: Trial ecologies generate new evidence but can consume irreplaceable samples or become settlements whose interests distort the release decision.
servati.editorial_notes: DRAFT local culture.

entries.Name: Unanswered Crews
entries.Description: DRAFT Corridor culture whose mobile crews inherit maintenance intervals and unanswered handoffs instead of permanent territory.

Formation.composition: Beacon maintainers, route auditors, refuge keepers, and listeners assigned to staggered sections of the corridor.

Dynamics.activity: Move between beacons, open scheduled receiving intervals, and record failures to answer without converting absence into death.
Dynamics.disposition: Exact about procedure, cautious about conclusions.
Dynamics.state: Still maintaining the chain while debating whether one section's resources should be diverted to reconnect Relay Twelve.

provenance.note: V11 supports unused beacon corridors. These crews, their mobility, and their Relay Twelve debate are DRAFT.

servati.preservation_problem: A crew carries procedural continuity between beacons, but each transfer of responsibility can silently replace purpose with habit.
servati.editorial_notes: DRAFT local culture.

entries.Name: Parallel Gallery Keepers
entries.Description: DRAFT Site Nine culture whose members are assigned in threes so a material, memorial, and relational reading accompany every intervention.

Formation.composition: Triads of matter handlers, identity witnesses, and pattern comparators, with no member authorised to certify the whole alone.

Dynamics.activity: Maintain parallel inventories, expose contradictions, and execute reversible repairs under explicit dissent.
Dynamics.disposition: Suspicious of clean syntheses and equally suspicious of inaction disguised as humility.
Dynamics.state: Operating with a damaged comparison rack after the Partition attempt.

provenance.note: V11 supports mixed sites and damaged comparison. These keepers, triads, and procedures are DRAFT.

servati.preservation_problem: Triadic custody preserves disagreement but can reproduce three institutional certainties instead of one genuinely shared comparison.
servati.editorial_notes: DRAFT local culture.

entries.Name: Rib-Quiet Descendant Branch
entries.Description: DRAFT post-human lineage associated with low-vibration archive work: deliberate movement, compliant contact surfaces, and heightened attention to structural noise are treated as task adaptations, not mystical traits.

Biology.appearance: Candidate bodies favour broad compliant foot and hand interfaces, compact movement, and protected sensory membranes; no fixed phenotype or genetic mechanism is approved.

Psychology.sociality: Work is organised around alternating quiet and witness groups rather than solitary silence.
Psychology.communication: Sealcloth gesture and contact signalling supplement speech near vulnerable systems.

provenance.note: V11 supports a culture shaped by silence and fragile identity fields, not this lineage phenotype. Every biological and cultural particular is DRAFT.

servati.preservation_problem: A task-adapted body preserves access to the Reef but risks making one ageing infrastructure's constraints hereditary.
servati.editorial_notes: DRAFT lineage; OnlyWorlds Species is used as an interoperability category, not a claim of non-human origin.

entries.Name: Load-Settled Descendant Branch
entries.Description: DRAFT K-6 lineage selected or designed around controlled carrying in low gravity, with joint stabilisation and fine acceleration sensing valued more than raw strength.

Biology.appearance: Candidate morphology includes stabilised joints, broad gripping structures, and dense proprioceptive interfaces; mass, mechanism, and development remain unspecified.

Psychology.instincts: Training and possible embodied bias favour stopping when load testimony conflicts rather than completing a route at any cost.
Psychology.communication: Load-angle marks and tactile handoff signals accompany ordinary speech.

provenance.note: V11 supports hand-carried burdens and Weight Doctrine cultures. This task-shaped lineage and phenotype are DRAFT.

servati.preservation_problem: Embodied route competence keeps burdens safe but may be impossible to transfer when the lineage, gravity environment, or road changes.
servati.editorial_notes: DRAFT lineage; adaptations require biomechanical review.

entries.Name: Threshold Walkers of Seven
entries.Description: DRAFT Pelagic lineage whose candidate pressure tolerance, tactile communication, and navigation are shaped by repeated work between surface station and submerged archive routes.

Biology.appearance: A pressure-adapted human branch is V11-compatible, but respiratory mode, pressure range, body form, and transition between environments remain deliberately unspecified.

Psychology.sociality: Route competence is taught in paired descents so a record of one body is checked by another.
Psychology.communication: Tactile and pressure-coded registers carry operational meaning where sight and speech are unreliable.

provenance.note: V11 explicitly supports pressure-adapted custodians. The Threshold Walker name, biology, practices, and limits are DRAFT.

servati.preservation_problem: Specialisation keeps submerged context accessible while making that context increasingly inaccessible to other human branches.
servati.editorial_notes: DRAFT lineage; pressure physiology requires expert review.

entries.Name: Viability Tender Descendant Branch
entries.Description: DRAFT Reserve Thirty-One lineage adapted culturally and perhaps biologically for low-contamination work, long maintenance cycles, and careful separation between keeper and held germline.

Biology.appearance: Candidate traits concern controllable shedding, microbiome management, and interface compatibility; no sterile-body fantasy or unsupported mechanism is asserted.

Psychology.temperament: Training rewards reversible intervention and explicit accounting for delay rather than automatic conservatism.
Psychology.communication: Release arguments are performed in paired conditional forms using the Interval Litany.

provenance.note: V11 supports Seed Lamp custodianship and obsolete release conditions. This lineage, phenotype, and social role are DRAFT.

servati.preservation_problem: Adapting custodians to the reserve reduces contamination but can make their own future dependent on never completing the reserve's purpose.
servati.editorial_notes: DRAFT lineage; biological feasibility remains open.

entries.Name: Interval Maintainer Descendant Branch
entries.Description: DRAFT Corridor lineage shaped by dispersed habitats, maintenance travel, radiation-managed work cycles, and responsibility for receiving windows longer than individual attention spans.

Biology.appearance: No visual form is fixed; candidate adaptations concern repairable radiation exposure, circadian flexibility, and long-isolation health rather than exotic ornament.

Psychology.sociality: Crews maintain overlapping duty memories so a missed interval cannot be assigned to one heroic keeper.
Psychology.communication: The Interval Litany binds checksum, acknowledgement state, and uncertainty into a repeatable handoff.

provenance.note: V11 supports long-maintained unused beacon routes. This descendant branch and its adaptations are DRAFT.

servati.preservation_problem: A lineage optimised for the route may preserve its intervals while losing the capacity to decide whether the route still deserves them.
servati.editorial_notes: DRAFT lineage; transport and radiation assumptions remain unmodelled.

entries.Name: Plural Frame Descendant Branch
entries.Description: DRAFT Site Nine lineage whose sensory and institutional training is designed to hold incompatible material, memorial, and pattern reports without prematurely resolving them.

Biology.appearance: No fixed morphology is approved; candidate interfaces preserve parallel sensory annotations rather than merging inputs into one authoritative display.

Psychology.instincts: Cultivated habits favour naming incompatible observations before choosing an action.
Psychology.sociality: Triads externalise disagreement; no claim of innate superior objectivity is made.

provenance.note: V11 supports mixed evidence and damaged comparison. This lineage and any embodied comparison interface are DRAFT.

servati.preservation_problem: A branch built to preserve contradiction may turn uncertainty into identity and resist justified resolution as a threat to itself.
servati.editorial_notes: DRAFT lineage; cognitive claims are institutional as much as biological and require review.

entries.Name: Rib-Zero Isolation Baffle
entries.Description: DRAFT Relay Twelve machine that isolates a witness chamber from structural vibration while preserving a trace of every isolation adjustment.

Form.aesthetics: A nested flexible coupling beside one pale radiator rib, its replacement layers left visible instead of faired smooth.

Function.utility: Reduce transmitted vibration and log the mechanical state under which an identity comparison was made.

provenance.note: V11 supports radiator ribs and vibration-threatened records. This baffle, logging function, and designation are DRAFT.

servati.preservation_problem: Replacing worn isolation layers improves protection but changes the mechanical history needed to compare old witness readings.
servati.editorial_notes: DRAFT machine; vibration performance requires engineering review.

entries.Name: K-6 Burden Sledge Four
entries.Description: DRAFT passive carrier whose compliant restraints, acceleration record, and replaceable wear surfaces let K-6 custodians move sealed matter without hiding route stress.

Form.aesthetics: A low frame with layered skids, visible repair plates, and a load surface marked by successive handoff geometries.

Function.utility: Carry a burden slowly while recording acceleration, rest thresholds, restraint changes, and disputed control.

provenance.note: V11 supports load limits, remembered transfer failures, and convoy redirection under vibration law. This sledge is DRAFT.

servati.preservation_problem: Wear records authenticate the route, but allowing wear to accumulate eventually endangers the matter the records are meant to protect.
servati.editorial_notes: DRAFT machine; load and low-gravity mechanics require review.

entries.Name: Marker Seven-Black-Three
entries.Description: DRAFT Pelagic route marker whose tactile faces and pressure response encode location, orientation, safe approach, and the uncertainty of its last emplacement.

Form.aesthetics: A dark ribbed marker designed to be read by touch and local pressure response rather than by an exposed visual label.

Function.utility: Bind a submerged route instruction to its physical depth, current, and tower relation.

provenance.note: V11 supports drowned route markers cut from rival-claimed towers. This marker's identity, form, and encoding are DRAFT.

servati.preservation_problem: Once removed, the marker survives as an object but its local pressure response becomes an unrepeatable claim about a lost placement.
servati.editorial_notes: DRAFT artefact; materials and sensor mechanism require review.

entries.Name: Thirty-One Release Condition Matrix
entries.Description: DRAFT layered interface that retains each surviving release rule, translation, failed environmental test, authority chain, and dissent without reducing them to one permission state.

Form.aesthetics: Concentric sealed panels whose mutually incompatible condition paths remain physically separated and jointly viewable.

Function.utility: Prevent activation software from treating an incomplete or translated condition set as unanimous release authority.

provenance.note: V11 supports obsolete conditions and false release orders. This matrix and its interface behaviour are DRAFT.

servati.preservation_problem: The matrix must accept new evidence without allowing an update to erase the exact obsolete rule it claims to supersede.
servati.editorial_notes: DRAFT artefact; information architecture and fail-safe behaviour require review.

entries.Name: No-Arrival Interval Clock
entries.Description: DRAFT distributed machine that records when a receiving interval was opened, what beacon state was observed, and which acknowledgements failed without displaying absence as a confirmed loss.

Form.aesthetics: A serviceable clock core surrounded by separate answer channels; dark channels remain labelled unknown rather than dead.

Function.utility: Coordinate route maintenance and preserve negative observations without converting them into invented arrivals or deaths.

provenance.note: V11 supports an unused maintained beacon corridor. This interval clock and its semantics are DRAFT.

servati.preservation_problem: Clock drift and reference loss require correction, yet correction can erase the timing uncertainty that makes an old missed answer interpretable.
servati.editorial_notes: DRAFT machine; timing architecture and transport physics require review.

entries.Name: Site Nine Parallel Comparison Rack
entries.Description: DRAFT rack that keeps matter scans, identity records, and pattern models aligned by relation without allowing any layer to overwrite another.

Form.aesthetics: Three offset frames share fiducial lines across an empty central gap, with damaged alignments left visibly discontinuous.

Function.utility: Support comparison, provisional repair, and dissent annotation while preserving source layers separately.

provenance.note: V11 supports damaged relation among evidence and copied records stripped of uncertainty. This rack is DRAFT.

servati.preservation_problem: Restoring damaged alignment helps comparison but can make a reconstructed relation indistinguishable from the relation originally observed.
servati.editorial_notes: DRAFT machine; sensing and storage mechanisms remain unspecified.

entries.Name: Sealcloth Gesture
entries.Description: DRAFT Relay Twelve operational language for communication when speech or equipment vibration is restricted; it carries source, confidence, negation, and request-for-witness explicitly.

Structure.grammar: Statements begin with evidence source and end with confidence or an unresolved-witness marker; commands require a visible scope gesture.
Structure.lexicon: The smallest preserved distinction is between not observed, cannot be queried, and confirmed absent.
Structure.writing: Gesture sequences are logged against a diagram of the radiator rib and witness chamber in which they were used.

provenance.source_location: Chapter 20 and Appendix XIV, source lines 1181 and 3373
provenance.note: V11 supports covered mouths and shallow gesture language in the Quiet Route. This register, grammar, and name are DRAFT.

servati.preservation_problem: A vibration-safe register preserves communication locally but loses nuance when copied without the chamber, rib, and witness context logged with it.
servati.editorial_notes: DRAFT language sketch, not a complete constructed language.

entries.Name: Load-Angle Notation
entries.Description: DRAFT K-6 engineering and custody register that treats slope, load, pause, transfer authority, and observed strain as one inspectable statement.

Structure.grammar: A valid line orders burden identity, carrier, route segment, measured condition, permitted next motion, and dissent mark.
Structure.lexicon: Terms distinguish weight carried, apparent load in motion, inherited burden, and authority to redirect.
Structure.writing: Incised route-angle strokes are overlaid with replaceable measurement films so historical marks remain visible beneath later readings.

provenance.note: V11 supports scripture made from route angles, load limits, and failure memory. This formal notation is DRAFT.

servati.preservation_problem: Updating measurements is necessary for safe carrying, but replacement can erase the old load conditions needed to understand a past failure.
servati.editorial_notes: DRAFT language sketch.

entries.Name: Current-Pressure Register
entries.Description: DRAFT Pelagic tactile and pressure-coded register used to describe approach, depth, current, contact order, and uncertainty where detached text would omit operational context.

Structure.phonology: No acoustic inventory is fixed; candidate transmission uses timed pressure changes and contact patterns alongside ordinary language.
Structure.grammar: Location is expressed as a path of changes rather than a detached coordinate, and every route statement marks whether the current was observed or reconstructed.
Structure.writing: Ribbed impressions preserve contact order but require a separate pressure and current record to be interpreted.

provenance.note: V11 supports pressure-adapted custodians and route markers. This register and all linguistic particulars are DRAFT.

servati.preservation_problem: The register keeps route context embodied, yet a recovered inscription cannot be read fully once the original pressure and current are gone.
servati.editorial_notes: DRAFT language sketch; underwater transmission mechanics require review.

entries.Name: Interval Litany
entries.Description: DRAFT procedural register shared imperfectly by Corridor crews and Reserve Thirty-One, derived from checksum and handoff forms but changed by their different ideas of release.

Structure.grammar: Each proposition pairs a condition with its observer, expiry rule, unanswered dependency, and permitted reversible action.
Structure.lexicon: Corridor usage distinguishes an open interval from an arrival; Seed usage distinguishes viability from authority to release.
Structure.writing: Checksummed blocks preserve alternative readings in parallel instead of normalising them into one command.

provenance.note: V11 supports route checksum becoming litany and obsolete release conditions. This shared register and its grammar are DRAFT.

servati.preservation_problem: A shared procedural language enables comparison, but local meanings of open, answer, viable, and release can make an apparently valid translation dangerous.
servati.editorial_notes: DRAFT language sketch; no full lexicon is asserted.

entries.Name: The Sixfold Custody Fracture
entries.Description: DRAFT narrative frame that orders the six existing Custody War incidents as one widening loss of comparison rather than six unrelated set pieces.

Context.story: A forced witness signal makes isolation politically suspect; a simplified identity index then travels faster than its missing uncertainty can be recognised. Its authority contaminates a release dispute, route jurisdictions harden around matter, contextual markers are removed, and the attempt to allocate a mixed site finally damages the comparison field meant to adjudicate all six harms.
Context.consequences: The Lamps become connected by disputed records and failed correction, not by an empire or conventional campaign. The order is editorially proposed and may be revised without changing V11.

provenance.note: V11 supports the conflict grammar and example types, not these names, causal links, or order. The complete sequence is DRAFT.

servati.preservation_problem: A coherent sequence makes the incidents legible but can harden a useful editorial arrangement into a falsely recovered chronology.
servati.editorial_notes: DRAFT relative sequence; no absolute dates or durations.

entries.Name: Quiet-Line Transcript Twelve-B
entries.Description: DRAFT recovered custody record presenting the Silence Breach through an exchange between a thermal maintainer and an outside witness channel.

Context.story: The local speaker refuses full-power transmission, names the identities placed at risk by silence, and asks the remote order to accept a slower channel. The remote answer treats delay as abandonment; the transcript ends with both warnings still active.
Context.consequences: Neither side is reduced to villainy, and the physical limit of the Reef remains inseparable from the moral claim.

provenance.note: The record is authored DRAFT fiction, not an actual source recovered from V11.

servati.preservation_problem: The transcript records competing harms but its damaged amplitude data cannot prove which transmission limit was physically necessary.
servati.editorial_notes: DRAFT internal-view record.

entries.Name: Refusal Pair Thirty-One
entries.Description: DRAFT recovered custody record preserving two simultaneous refusals: one to obey an unverifiable release order and one to pretend continued dormancy is harmless.

Context.story: Paired advocates recite the same condition matrix. One demonstrates that the authority chain is broken; the other enters the viability losses expected from another closed interval. Both sign the continued closure and preserve their accusations against it.
Context.consequences: The reserve remains closed without allowing non-release to masquerade as certainty or innocence.

provenance.note: The record is authored DRAFT fiction, not an actual source recovered from V11.

servati.preservation_problem: The refusal records anticipated loss, but incomplete viability science prevents later custodians from separating honest forecast from doctrinal pressure.
servati.editorial_notes: DRAFT internal-view record.

entries.Name: Ash Convoy Handoff Leaf
entries.Description: DRAFT recovered custody record in which two route authorities annotate the same burden movement without either breaking the seal or accepting the other's jurisdiction.

Context.story: A sledge stops between thresholds. One bench enters the angle as lawful continuation; another enters it as the first segment of unlawful diversion. The load record agrees while the authority fields split.
Context.consequences: The matter arrives intact, but later keepers inherit two physically evidenced routes and no neutral handoff term.

provenance.note: The record is authored DRAFT fiction, not an actual source recovered from V11.

servati.preservation_problem: The leaf preserves both readings but cannot preserve the lost shared vocabulary that would have made them comparable.
servati.editorial_notes: DRAFT internal-view record.

entries.Name: Site Nine Parallel Inventory Fragment
entries.Description: DRAFT recovered custody record showing three inventories disagreeing over one damaged frame while preserving the exact points at which their categories fail to align.

Context.story: The matter bench lists a frame segment, the memory bench lists two partial names, and the pattern bench lists one uncertain relation. A partition order asks for three holdings; the inventory answers that cutting the frame would also cut the comparison.
Context.consequences: The fragment establishes why the Concordance resisted division without proving that every later refusal was justified.

provenance.note: The record is authored DRAFT fiction, not an actual source recovered from V11.

servati.preservation_problem: Keeping categories separate makes disagreement visible, but the surviving fragment cannot show whether an omitted fourth account once changed the relation.
servati.editorial_notes: DRAFT internal-view record.

entries.Name: Quiet-Line Witness Accord
entries.Description: DRAFT conditional relation between Relay Twelve and Corridor crews: low-energy route channels may carry witness summaries while full archive fields remain locally protected.

Nature.background: Proposed after the Silence Breach as a compromise between total quiet and compelled high-energy witness transmission.

provenance.note: DRAFT relation built from existing DRAFT sites and incident; not V11 fact.

servati.preservation_problem: Summaries reduce physical risk but can become detached substitutes for the uncertain records they summarise.
servati.editorial_notes: DRAFT inter-Lamp relation.

entries.Name: Ash-Nine Burden Provenance Route
entries.Description: DRAFT relation by which K-6 route evidence is compared with damaged frames at Site Nine, making each location useful to the other and vulnerable to the other's doctrine.

Nature.background: The redirected Ash Convoy leaves incompatible route records that Site Nine can compare but not reconcile; the later Partition threatens the shared field.

provenance.note: DRAFT relation; V11 does not connect these candidate sites.

servati.preservation_problem: Moving evidence enables cross-checking but adds a new route history whose disputes can obscure the original one.
servati.editorial_notes: DRAFT inter-Lamp relation.

entries.Name: Pelagic-Nine Context Exchange
entries.Description: DRAFT relation in which Pelagic route contexts test Site Nine's comparison methods while Site Nine preserves displaced markers without claiming to restore their original placement.

Nature.background: Created around markers displaced during the Drowned Marker Seizure and contested again when Site Nine is ordered to partition its holdings.

provenance.note: DRAFT relation; V11 does not connect these candidate sites.

servati.preservation_problem: A displaced marker needs external custody, yet every external description risks being mistaken for the lost submerged relation itself.
servati.editorial_notes: DRAFT inter-Lamp relation.

entries.Name: Thirty-One Interval Verification
entries.Description: DRAFT relation under which Corridor crews verify message path and interval state for Seed Reserve Thirty-One without claiming authority over biological release.

Nature.background: The False Release exposes the difference between a technically valid route and a valid custody authority.

provenance.note: DRAFT relation built to preserve a boundary between transport proof and release authority.

servati.preservation_problem: Separating route verification from release authority limits forgery but creates an interface where each institution can disclaim the other's failure.
servati.editorial_notes: DRAFT inter-Lamp relation.

entries.Name: Six-Lamp Correction Circuit
entries.Description: DRAFT relation linking all six Lamps through partial checks: no site can certify the whole, but each can expose a characteristic failure in another's evidence.

Nature.background: The circuit emerges from shared failures during the Sixfold Custody Fracture, not from political unification or common command.

provenance.note: DRAFT cluster device; V11 supports cross-correction as a lost possibility but not this circuit.

servati.preservation_problem: Cross-correction restores comparison but gives every participant new power to obstruct, reinterpret, or expose another site's custody.
servati.editorial_notes: DRAFT cluster relation; it is not an alliance, empire, or unified authority.

entries.Name: Uncertainty-Stripped Index Propagation
entries.Description: DRAFT relation tracing how one useful but simplified identity index moves among Relay Twelve, Reserve Thirty-One, and Site Nine and changes decisions before its omissions are recognised.

Nature.background: The Index Without Uncertainty becomes the connective evidence behind later disputes rather than a weapon belonging to a conventional antagonist.

provenance.note: V11 supports uncertainty-stripped copies and false-certainty poisoning separately. This propagation path and linked sites are DRAFT.

servati.preservation_problem: The copy must remain available as evidence of past decisions while interfaces and custodians must be prevented from treating it as complete identity truth.
servati.editorial_notes: DRAFT damaged-provenance relation.
